verdict.rationale: Insomnia supports declarative artifacts (OpenAPI specs, collections) with Git Sync keeping project data in a repo, and the Inso CLI is explicitly designed to run in CI (lint specs, run tests, exit codes) enabling APIOps-style pipelines. However this is oriented around API client/design workflows rather than full gateway/infrastructure-as-config management (e.g., no evidence of declarative gateway route/plugin config synced from CI, no Terraform/Kong-declarative-config integration shown). missing for 10: evidence of managing actual gateway/infrastructure config (routes, plugins, services) as code, integration with a GitOps controller/pipeline beyond linting/testing, and independent/hands-on validation of CI sync workflows.
